top_signals.title: Meituan’s 500% Estimate Surge May Revive China Delivery Stocks
top_signals.summary: The latest batch of earnings showed the impact of China’s intense food-delivery price competition is fading more quickly than expected, removing a major drag on sector stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
